_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_name.label: County Name
county_name.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of_decedent.label: Estate Of Decedent
estate_of_decedent.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

personal_representative_name.label: Personal Representative Name
personal_representative_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

further_verify_actions.label: Further Verify Actions
further_verify_actions.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

provisions_details.label: Provisions Details
provisions_details.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

pr_signature_date.label: Pr Signature Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

notary_county.label: Notary County
notary_county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

notary_appearance_name.label: Notary Appearance Name
notary_appearance_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notary_officer_name.label: Notary Officer Name
notary_officer_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
